description: This file defines functions to create channel directory adapters for a plugin system, including default implementations for 'self' and 'listPeers'. It exports utility functions to instantiate adapters with default or empty behaviors.

methods.name: nullChannelDirectorySelf
methods.description: Default null implementation for 'self' property of a ChannelDirectoryAdapter, returns null asynchronously.

methods.name: emptyChannelDirectoryList
methods.description: Default empty list implementation for 'listPeers' property of a ChannelDirectoryAdapter, returns an empty array asynchronously.

methods.name: export function createChannelDirectoryAdapter( createChannelDirectoryAdapter
methods.description: Factory function to create a ChannelDirectoryAdapter with default or provided 'self' and other properties.

methods.name: export function createEmptyChannelDirectoryAdapter(): ChannelDirectoryAdapter { createEmptyChannelDirectoryAdapter
methods.description: Creates a ChannelDirectoryAdapter with empty behaviors for directory support, for use in channels without directory features.

calls: return createChannelDirectoryAdapter({ listPeers: emptyChannelDirectoryList, listGroups: emptyChannelDirectoryList })
